AI Engineer - Northwind Labs (remote, Europe)

Northwind Labs builds conversational commerce tools for online shops. Our assistant answers shoppers on WhatsApp and the web for more than 400 merchants.

What you will do:
- Design, ship and monitor LLM features that talk to real customers.
- Build evaluation pipelines that catch regressions before they reach merchants.
- Work closely with the product team and explain trade-offs in plain language.

What we look for:
- You have shipped at least one LLM feature to production users.
- You measure quality with evals, not vibes.
- You communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues.

How we work: small team, weekly releases, async first. The interview process has a screening call, a technical case study and a final call with the founders.
